baseTexts: runs/r1/reference-output.jsonl (18 texts, all accepted by the v1 checker)
note: Each probe is one mechanical edit of a reference text. 'fail' means at least one hard finding with one of the listed codes. 'review' means no hard finding but a review item whose residual run contains the listed substring; a human verdict is required before the item is accepted.

probes.mutation: reverse the order of all four sentences
probes.text: 陈默的袖口湿到肘部。随后，陈默的鞋底沾了泥。周宁的斗篷下摆湿了一片。林川的袖口沾了雨，指节发白。
probes.note: v1 accepted this: it only compared adjacent groups for 'different sentence'.

probes.mutation: prefix the 周宁 sentence (not the edge target) with 随后
